gloss: temperature difference; fluctuation between hot and cold

definitions.explanation: the difference or fluctuation between cold and warm temperatures, especially between day and night or between seasons

examples.japanese: {寒暖差|かんだんさ}が{激|はげ}しい。
{春|はる}は{寒暖差|かんだんさ}で{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすい。
examples.english: In spring, the temperature fluctuations make it easy to get sick.

examples.japanese: {昼|ひる}と{夜|よる}の{寒暖差|かんだんさ}が{大|おお}きい{地域|ちいき}ではおいしいりんごが{育|そだ}つ。
examples.english: Delicious apples grow in areas with large day-night temperature differences.

notes:
{寒暖差|かんだんさ} refers to temperature fluctuation, commonly discussed in weather forecasts and health contexts.

COMPOSITION:
- {寒|かん}: Cold
- {暖|だん}: Warm
- {差|さ}: Difference

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒暖差|かんだんさ}が{激|はげ}しい (extreme temperature fluctuation)
- {寒暖差|かんだんさ}が{大|おお}きい (large temperature difference)
- {一日|いちにち}の{寒暖差|かんだんさ} (daily temperature variation)
- {寒暖差|かんだんさ}アレルギー (temperature change allergy)
- {寒暖差|かんだんさ}{疲労|ひろう} (fatigue from temperature fluctuation)

HEALTH CONTEXT:
{寒暖差|かんだんさ} is often mentioned in relation to health, as sudden temperature changes can trigger colds, allergies, or fatigue.

RELATED TERMS:
- {気温差|きおんさ} (temperature difference - more technical)
- {温度差|おんどさ} (temperature difference - general)
- {寒暖|かんだん} (hot and cold)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in weather forecasts and health discussions.
